stages.description: Screening test consisting of two objective papers. Marks in Paper I determine qualifying cutoff for Mains, while Paper II is qualifying (min 33%).

topics.title: Current Events of National and International Importance
topics.description: Critical domestic policies, multilateral summits, geopolitical shifts, national awards, and strategic bilateral relations.
sub_points: National initiatives, welfare policies, and statutory schemes
Bilateral, regional and multilateral agreements and groupings
Major international summits, conventions, and global health/environment declarations

topics.title: History of India and Indian National Movement
topics.description: Ancient, medieval, modern Indian history and the multi-phased Indian freedom struggle.
sub_points: Ancient civilization: Indus Valley, Vedic period, Mauryan and Gupta eras
Medieval culture, Bhakti and Sufi movements, Vijayanagara and Mughal administrations
Modern freedom struggle: 1857 Revolt to 1947 independence, Gandhian phases, revolutionary movements

topics.title: Indian and World Geography - Physical, Social, Economic
topics.description: Geomorphology, climatology, oceanography, biogeography, and resource distribution of India and the world.
sub_points: Physical geography: plate tectonics, seismic zones, monsoon dynamics, river basins
Economic geography: key mineral reserves, agricultural cropping belts, industrial clusters
Human & social geography: demographics, migration patterns, urbanization challenges

topics.title: Indian Polity and Governance - Constitution, Political System, Panchayati Raj
topics.description: Constitutional philosophy, fundamental rights, directive principles, executive, judiciary, federal structure, and public policy.
sub_points: Preamble, Fundamental Rights (Articles 12-35), Directive Principles, and Fundamental Duties
Parliament, State Legislatures, Judicial Review, and Basic Structure Doctrine
73rd & 74th Constitutional Amendment Acts (Panchayati Raj & Municipalities)
Statutory, regulatory and constitutional bodies (ECI, CAG, UPSC, Finance Commission)

topics.title: Economic and Social Development - Sustainable Development, Poverty, Inclusion
topics.description: Macroeconomic aggregates, fiscal and monetary policies, banking sector reforms, budget analysis, and inclusive growth.
sub_points: National income accounting, GDP growth paradigms, inflation management
Monetary Policy Committee framework, RBI instruments, banking NPA resolutions
Union Budget, Fiscal Responsibility and Budget Management (FRBM) targets
Poverty line estimations, multidimensional poverty, social security programmes

topics.title: General Issues on Environmental Ecology, Bio-diversity and Climate Change
topics.description: Ecosystem dynamics, conservation treaties, national parks, wildlife protection legislation, and climate diplomacy.
sub_points: Terrestrial and aquatic ecosystems, food webs, ecological succession
Wildlife Protection Act 1972, Project Tiger/Elephant, Ramsar wetland sites, Biosphere Reserves
UNFCCC COPs, Paris Agreement NDC targets, carbon markets, renewable energy targets

topics.title: General Science & Emerging Technologies
topics.description: Core scientific principles, space missions, biotechnology, defense technologies, and digital public infrastructure.
sub_points: ISRO space exploration missions (Gaganyaan, Chandrayaan, Aditya-L1)
Biotechnology, gene editing (CRISPR), mRNA vaccines, disease transmission
Artificial intelligence, quantum computing, semiconductors, 5G/6G architecture

papers.paper_name: Paper II: Civil Services Aptitude Test (CSAT)

topics.title: Reading Comprehension & Critical Inferences
topics.description: Dense passages drawn from economics, ecology, philosophy, and sociology testing analytical inference and deduction.
sub_points: Identification of underlying assumptions, core arguments, and logical corollaries
Tone analysis, critical message extraction, and implication synthesis

topics.title: Logical Reasoning and Analytical Ability
topics.description: Deductive reasoning, syllogisms, relational puzzles, spatial patterns, and algorithmic decision pathways.
sub_points: Syllogisms, statement-conclusion, statement-assumption paradigms
Complex seating arrangements, blood relations, direction sense tests
Coding-decoding, sequential series, and conditional matrix puzzles

topics.title: Basic Numeracy & Data Interpretation (Class X Level)
topics.description: Arithmetic principles, number system hierarchies, permutations, probability, and quantitative data representations.
sub_points: Number systems: prime numbers, divisibility tests, remainders, LCM & HCF
Percentages, profit & loss, ratio & proportion, time & work, speed & distance
Permutations & combinations, basic probability, Venn diagrams
Data interpretation: charts, graphs, tables, and data sufficiency

stages.description: 9 conventional essay-type papers designed to test academic depth and analytical articulation. 2 qualifying language papers (300m each) + 7 merit papers (250m each).

papers.merit_status: Qualifying Only (Min 75/300 required; not counted in rank)
papers.source_clause: Appendix II, Section II Paper A

topics.title: Comprehension & Precis Writing in Selected 8th Schedule Language
topics.description: Reading comprehension, condensation of prose, idiomatic usage, and bilateral translation between English and Indian language.
sub_points: Comprehension of given passages with subjective answers
Precis writing of given text into one-third length
Usage, idioms, proverbs, and syntactic vocabulary
Translation from English to the Indian language and vice-versa

papers.merit_status: Qualifying Only (Min 75/300 required; not counted in rank)
papers.source_clause: Appendix II, Section II Paper B

topics.title: English Comprehension, Precis & Composition
topics.description: Tests candidate's ability to read and understand serious discursive prose and express ideas clearly and correctly in English.
sub_points: Comprehension of unseen passages
Precis writing with strict adherence to word limits
Grammar, vocabulary, correction of sentences, prepositions
Short essay composition on contemporary themes

papers.source_clause: Appendix II, Section II Paper I

topics.title: Section A: Philosophical & Abstract Themes
topics.description: In-depth exposition on ethical aphorisms, human condition, epistemology, and socio-philosophical maxims.
sub_points: Epistemological inquiries, ethics, and moral philosophy
Human values, civilization dialogues, and existential reflections

topics.title: Section B: Socio-Economic, Technological & Governance Themes
topics.description: Critical analysis of contemporary societal transformations, economic paradigms, constitutional morality, and scientific frontiers.
sub_points: Inclusive economic growth, agrarian distress, sustainable industrialization
Artificial intelligence ethics, digital privacy, and governance equity

papers.paper_name: Paper II: General Studies I (Heritage, Culture, History & Geography)
papers.source_clause: Appendix II, Section II Paper II (GS-1)

topics.title: Indian Heritage, Art Forms, Literature & Architecture
topics.description: Evolution of architecture, sculpture, painting, music, performing arts, and classical literature from ancient to modern eras.
sub_points: Temple architecture: Nagara, Dravida, and Vesara styles; Buddhist rock-cut architecture
Classical dance traditions, folk music, miniature and mural painting schools
Sanskrit literature, Sangam poetry, Persian chronicles, and modern vernacular writings

topics.title: Modern Indian History & Freedom Struggle (Mid-18th Century to 1947)
topics.description: British expansionist policies, socio-religious reform movements, emergence of nationalism, and constitutional milestones.
sub_points: Colonial land revenue settlements (Permanent Settlement, Ryotwari, Mahalwari) and economic drain
19th-century socio-religious reform movements (Raja Ram Mohan Roy, Arya Samaj, Aligarh Movement)
Phases of Freedom Struggle: Moderates, Extremists, Swadeshi, Non-Cooperation, Civil Disobedience, Quit India
Role of prominent personalities, tribal uprisings, and peasant revolts

topics.title: Post-Independence Consolidation and Reorganization
topics.description: Integration of princely states, linguistic reorganization of states, tribal consolidation, and nation-building initiatives.
sub_points: Sardar Patel's integration of princely states; Kashmir, Hyderabad, and Junagadh accessions
States Reorganisation Commission (SRC 1956) and linguistic identity movements
Early five-year plans, Green Revolution, and foreign policy non-alignment

topics.title: History of the World (18th Century to Modern Era)
topics.description: Major global political upheavals, ideological confrontations, industrialization, imperialism, and decolonization.
sub_points: Industrial Revolution, American Revolution (1776), French Revolution (1789)
World War I, Russian Revolution (1917), Rise of Fascism and Nazism, World War II
Cold War dynamics, dismantling of colonial empires in Asia and Africa, fall of the Soviet Union

topics.title: Salient Features of Indian Society, Diversity, Women & Secularism
topics.description: Structure of Indian society, caste hierarchy transformations, women's empowerment, regionalism, communalism, and globalization impact.
sub_points: Caste dynamics, kinship systems, family structures, and changing demographic profiles
Role of women and women's organizations; female labor force participation; gender justice
Effects of globalization on traditional culture, consumerism, and youth aspirations
Communalism, regionalism, secularism, and social empowerment policies

topics.title: Physical Geography, Resource Distribution & Geophysical Phenomena
topics.description: Global physical phenomena, resource geopolitics, ocean resources, and natural hazard vulnerability.
sub_points: Plate tectonics, volcanism, earthquakes, tsunamis, tropical cyclones
Distribution of key natural resources (iron, coal, petroleum, lithium, rare earth elements)
Factors determining location of primary, secondary, and tertiary sector industries globally

papers.paper_name: Paper III: General Studies II (Governance, Polity, Social Justice & IR)
papers.source_clause: Appendix II, Section II Paper III (GS-2)

topics.title: Indian Constitution - Evolution, Amendments, Federalism & Separation of Powers
topics.description: Constitutional provisions, federal tensions, emergency provisions, judicial activism, and comparative constitutional designs.
sub_points: Basic Structure Doctrine evolution, landmark judicial verdicts (Kesavananda Bharati to present)
Union-State relations: legislative, administrative, financial; role of the Governor; Inter-State Council
Separation of powers, checks and balances, public interest litigations (PILs)
Comparison of Indian constitutional scheme with US, UK, France, and Germany

topics.title: Parliament & State Legislatures - Functioning, Privileges & Representation of People Act
topics.description: Legislative conduct, committee system, decline of parliamentary debates, anti-defection law, and electoral reforms.
sub_points: Parliamentary committees (Public Accounts Committee, Estimates Committee, Departmentally Related Standing Committees)
Tenth Schedule (Anti-Defection Law) challenges, disqualifications, office of profit
Representation of the People Act 1950 & 1951: electoral financing, criminalization of politics

topics.title: Governance, Transparency, Accountability & Citizen Charters
topics.description: E-governance paradigms, Right to Information, role of civil services in democracy, and accountability mechanisms.
sub_points: Right to Information Act 2005: implementation bottlenecks and recent amendments
Citizen's Charters, Social Audits, Sevottam model, public grievance redressal mechanisms
Role of civil services in a democracy: neutrality, commitment to constitution, Mission Karmayogi

topics.title: Welfare Schemes, Poverty, Hunger & Social Sector (Health, Education)
topics.description: Human development challenges, public health infrastructure, National Education Policy, and vulnerable section protections.
sub_points: Issues relating to poverty, malnutrition, Global Hunger Index metrics, and PDS reforms
Healthcare infrastructure: Ayushman Bharat, Universal Health Coverage, primary health centres
National Education Policy 2020, foundational literacy and numeracy, higher education reforms
Protection of SC/ST, OBC, Minorities, Divyangjan, and Senior Citizens

topics.title: International Relations, India's Neighbourhood & Multilateral Fora
topics.description: India's foreign policy doctrines, neighborhood relations, major power engagements, and global multilateral governance.
sub_points: Neighborhood First Policy, Act East Policy, SAGAR doctrine, Middle East engagements
Strategic bilateral ties: USA, Russia, China, Japan, EU; geopolitical conflicts
Multilateral groupings: Quad, BRICS, SCO, G20, UN Security Council reforms, WTO, IMF

papers.paper_name: Paper IV: General Studies III (Technology, Economy, Environment & Security)
papers.source_clause: Appendix II, Section II Paper IV (GS-3)

topics.title: Indian Economy, Resource Mobilization, Budgeting & Inclusive Growth
topics.description: Economic survey findings, fiscal consolidation, capital expenditure cycles, GST architecture, and employment generation.
sub_points: Gross Value Added (GVA) trends, manufacturing revival (Make in India, PLI schemes)
Goods and Services Tax (GST) council dynamics, fiscal federalism, direct tax reforms
Employment generation: formalization of labor, gig economy, periodic labor force survey data

topics.title: Agriculture, Food Processing, MSP & Land Reforms
topics.description: Cropping patterns, irrigation infrastructure, minimum support price debates, food subsidy burden, and supply chain logistics.
sub_points: Direct and indirect farm subsidies, MSP calculation methodology (A2+FL vs C2)
Public Distribution System (PDS) efficiency, buffer stock management, NFSA targets
Food processing industries: upstream and downstream linkages, cold storage supply chain
Land reforms: digitization of land records (DILRMP), land leasing frameworks

topics.title: Science & Technology Indigenization, Space, IT & IPR
topics.description: Indigenous technological breakthroughs, space missions, semiconductor manufacturing, robotics, and patent laws.
sub_points: National Quantum Mission, India Semiconductor Mission, AI computational clusters
Space sector reforms: IN-SPACe, private participation, deep space missions
Intellectual Property Rights (IPR) regime, patent litigation, Compulsory Licensing

topics.title: Environmental Conservation, Pollution & Disaster Management Framework
topics.description: National Clean Air Programme, circular economy, renewable energy transitions, and Sendai Framework implementation.
sub_points: Air and water pollution control, plastic waste management rules, River Ganga rejuvenation
Panchamrit climate goals (500 GW non-fossil capacity, Net Zero 2070)
Disaster Management Act 2005, NDMA guidelines, early warning systems, flood/landslide mitigation

topics.title: Internal Security, Border Management, Cyber Warfare & Money Laundering
topics.description: Left-wing extremism, insurgency in North-East, border policing, cyber threats, and terror financing networks.
sub_points: Linkages between development and spread of extremism; Naxalite insurgency containment
Border security architecture: Comprehensive Integrated Border Management System (CIBMS)
Cyber warfare, data sovereignty, critical information infrastructure protection (CERT-In)
Money laundering, Prevention of Money Laundering Act (PMLA), FATF compliance

papers.paper_name: Paper V: General Studies IV (Ethics, Integrity and Aptitude)
papers.question_type: Descriptive Written (13 Questions: 6 Theory + 7 Case Studies)
papers.source_clause: Appendix II, Section II Paper V (GS-4)

topics.title: Ethics and Human Interface - Essence, Determinants & Consequences
topics.description: Ethical dimensions in private and public relationships, moral philosophers, and virtue ethics.
sub_points: Deontological, teleological, and virtue ethics frameworks in governance
Human values derived from lives of exemplary administrators and moral thinkers
Role of family, educational institutions, and society in inculcating ethical compass

topics.title: Civil Service Values, Integrity, Neutrality & Emotional Intelligence
topics.description: Foundational ethos for public servants: integrity, impartiality, non-partisanship, empathy, and emotional quotient.
sub_points: Integrity and probity in public office; conflict of interest identification
Impartiality and political neutrality; dedicated service to weaker sections
Emotional Intelligence: components, self-regulation, empathy, and bureaucratic utility

topics.title: Probity in Governance, RTI, Codes of Conduct & Citizen Charters
topics.description: Philosophical basis of governance, institutional mechanisms for preventing corruption, and Whistleblower protection.
sub_points: Central Vigilance Commission (CVC), Lokpal and Lokayuktas Act, Prevention of Corruption Act
Codes of Conduct vs Codes of Ethics; adherence to statutory guidelines
Public funds utilization, procurement integrity, and contract transparency

topics.title: Applied Ethics Case Studies on Administrative Dilemmas
topics.description: Real-world administrative scenarios testing decision-making under conflicting legal, political, and moral pressures.
sub_points: Disaster relief distribution equity under resource scarcity
Encounter killings vs rule of law; mob violence containment
Whistleblowing against political superiors; tender awarding integrity

papers.source_clause: Appendix II, Section II Optional Subjects

topics.title: Optional Discipline Fundamentals & Theoretical Frameworks
topics.description: Advanced graduate-level exploration of chosen discipline (e.g., Public Administration, PSIR, History, Geography, Economics, Sociology, Law, Engineering).
sub_points: Core foundational theories, philosophical evolution, and canonical paradigms
Comparative analytical approaches and seminal scholarly contributions

papers.source_clause: Appendix II, Section II Optional Subjects

topics.title: Optional Discipline Applied Concepts & Indian Contextualization
topics.description: Domain-specific applied problems, policy case studies, and contextual Indian developments in the chosen discipline.
sub_points: Empirical studies, national policy applications, and institutional frameworks
Contemporary debates, recent statutory developments, and sectorial challenges

stages.description: The candidate is interviewed by a Board of competent and unbiased observers to assess personal suitability for civil services.

topics.title: Assessment of Mental Caliber, Moral Integrity & Social Suitability
topics.description: Evaluates intellectual curiosity, critical powers of assimilation, clear and logical exposition, balance of judgment, alertness of mind, and moral integrity.
sub_points: Detailed Application Form (DAF) verification: academic background, service preferences, hobbies
Critical perspective on complex socio-economic and national security dilemmas
Composure under stress, leadership qualities, and empathetic temperament

stages.description: 100 marks 3-hour single paper consisting of 15 marks General Aptitude + 85 marks Technical Core & Engineering Mathematics.

papers.paper_name: Section 1: General Aptitude (Common to All Streams)
papers.negative_marking: 1/3rd deduction on MCQs; No negative marking on NAT/MSQ

topics.title: Verbal Aptitude: English Grammar & Reading Comprehension
topics.description: Basic English grammar, tenses, subject-verb agreement, vocabulary in context, and narrative sequencing.
sub_points: Articles, prepositions, conjunctions, verb tenses, conditional structures
Vocabulary, synonyms, antonyms, idioms, analogies
Reading comprehension and analytical narrative deduction

topics.title: Quantitative Aptitude: Data Interpretation & Numerical Reasoning
topics.description: Data representation, elementary statistics, permutations, probability, algebra, and geometry.
sub_points: Bar charts, pie charts, scatter plots, tabular data sufficiency
Percentages, ratios, powers, exponents, logarithms, permutations & combinations
Elementary 2D and 3D geometry, mensuration, coordinate trigonometry

topics.title: Analytical & Spatial Aptitude: Logic & Shape Transformations
topics.description: Deductive logic, syllogisms, pattern recognition, spatial paper folding, mirror images, and grouping.
sub_points: Logical deduction, analogy, numerical series, conditional relations
Spatial assembly, rotation, mirroring, paper folding, and 2D/3D projections

topics.title: Engineering Mathematics (Linear Algebra, Calculus, Differential Equations)
topics.description: Matrices, eigenvalues, vector calculus, ordinary and partial differential equations, complex variables, and numerical methods.
sub_points: Matrix algebra, systems of linear equations, eigenvalues and eigenvectors
Taylor series, gradient, divergence, curl, Stokes theorem, Gauss divergence theorem
First order ODEs, higher order linear ODEs with constant coefficients, Laplace transforms

topics.title: Applied Mechanics and Design: Mechanics of Materials & Theory of Machines
topics.description: Free-body diagrams, stress-strain relations, mohr circle, beams, shafts, governors, vibration analysis, and machine design.
sub_points: Stress, strain, Hooke's law, Mohr's circle for plane stress and plane strain
Bending moment and shear force diagrams, deflection of beams, Euler's buckling theory
Kinematics of planar mechanisms, gears and gear trains, flywheels, governors
Free and forced single degree of freedom vibrations, resonance, damping

topics.title: Fluid Mechanics and Thermal Sciences: Thermodynamics & Heat Transfer
topics.description: Continuity and Navier-Stokes equations, Rankine, Otto, Diesel, Brayton cycles, conduction, convection, and radiation.
sub_points: Fluid statics, Bernoulli's equation, boundary layer theory, pipe flow losses
First and second laws of thermodynamics, entropy, exergy, thermodynamic cycles
Steady and unsteady heat conduction, lumped parameter analysis, Nusselt number correlations
Radiation laws, Stefan-Boltzmann, Wien displacement law, radiation shield design

topics.title: Materials, Manufacturing and Industrial Engineering
topics.description: Casting, metal forming, welding, machining, CNC programming, metrology, operations research, and inventory control.
sub_points: Iron-carbon phase diagram, heat treatment of steels, TTT diagrams
Gating system design, rolling, forging, extrusion, wire drawing mechanics
Orthogonal cutting, Taylor's tool life equation, Merchant circle analysis
Linear programming, simplex method, transportation model, EOQ models

topics.title: Structural Engineering: Solid Mechanics, Concrete & Steel Structures
topics.description: Indeterminate analysis, slope deflection, moment distribution, limit state design of beams, columns, and steel connections.
sub_points: Statically determinate and indeterminate trusses, beams, and frames
Limit state design of reinforced concrete beams, slabs, columns, and footings (IS 456)
Design of tension and compression steel members, bolted and welded joints (IS 800)

topics.title: Geotechnical & Foundation Engineering
topics.description: Soil classification, effective stress, permeability, compaction, consolidation, shear strength, shallow and deep foundations.
sub_points: Three-phase system, Atterberg limits, Indian Standard soil classification
Terzaghi's 1D consolidation theory, Mohr-Coulomb failure criterion, direct shear test
Bearing capacity theories (Terzaghi, Meyerhof), pile load capacity in clays and sands

topics.title: Water Resources & Environmental Engineering
topics.description: Fluid mechanics, open channel hydraulics, unit hydrographs, water treatment plant design, and wastewater quality.
sub_points: Specific energy, hydraulic jump in open channels, Manning and Chezy equations
Unit hydrograph derivation, rational method for flood estimation, well hydraulics
Water treatment unit processes: coagulation, flocculation, sedimentation, rapid sand filtration
Activated sludge process, BOD kinetics, sludge digestion, air pollution standards

topics.title: Transportation Engineering & Geomatics (Surveying)
topics.description: Highway geometric design, pavement thickness, traffic capacity, leveling, EDM, and photogrammetry.
sub_points: Stopping and overtaking sight distances, super-elevation design, horizontal and vertical curves
Flexible and rigid pavement design components (IRC standards), CBR method
Levelling, reciprocal levelling, total station surveying, GPS and GIS basics

topics.title: Electric Circuits & Electromagnetic Fields
topics.description: Network theorems, transient response, sinusoidal steady state, Maxwell's equations, and electrostatic boundary conditions.
sub_points: Thevenin, Norton, Superposition, Maximum Power Transfer theorems; graph theory
RL, RC, RLC transient analysis with DC and sinusoidal excitations, resonance
Gauss's law, Biot-Savart law, Ampere's law, Faraday's law, Poynting vector

topics.title: Signals and Systems & Control Systems
topics.description: LTI systems, Fourier series, Laplace transforms, Z-transforms, root locus, Bode plot, Nyquist stability, state-space models.
sub_points: Continuous and discrete time LTI systems, convolution, sampling theorem
Routh-Hurwitz criterion, root locus plotting rules, lead-lag compensator design
Bode and Nyquist stability criteria, gain margin, phase margin, state transition matrix

topics.title: Electrical Machines: Transformers, Induction & Synchronous Machines
topics.description: Equivalent circuits, phasor diagrams, torque-speed characteristics, open-circuit/short-circuit tests, and motor drives.
sub_points: Single-phase and three-phase transformers: losses, efficiency, regulation, auto-transformers
Three-phase induction motors: equivalent circuit, torque-slip curves, starting methods
Synchronous generators: cylindrical and salient pole machines, voltage regulation, V-curves

topics.title: Power Systems, Protection & Power Electronics
topics.description: Transmission line parameters, load flow (Gauss-Seidel, Newton-Raphson), fault analysis, thyristors, inverters, and choppers.
sub_points: ABCD parameters of transmission lines, surge impedance loading, Ferranti effect
Symmetrical and unsymmetrical fault calculations using symmetrical components
Differential relays, distance relays, numerical protection schemes
Phase-controlled rectifiers, buck/boost converters, voltage source inverters, PWM

topics.title: Electronic Devices, Analog & Digital Circuits
topics.description: Energy bands, p-n junctions, MOSFET characteristics, op-amps, feedback amplifiers, combinational logic, and microprocessors.
sub_points: Carrier transport in semiconductors, drift, diffusion, continuity equation, MOS capacitor
BJT and MOSFET small-signal amplifiers, differential amplifiers, frequency response
Ideal and practical op-amp circuits, active filters, Schmitt triggers, oscillators
Boolean algebra, Karnaugh maps, flip-flops, synchronous counters, finite state machines

topics.title: Communications & Electromagnetics
topics.description: Analog and digital modulation (AM, FM, PSK, QAM), noise analysis, information theory, transmission lines, and antennas.
sub_points: AM and FM transmitters/receivers, superheterodyne receivers, SNR calculations
PCM, DPCM, ASK, FSK, PSK, QAM, matched filter receivers, bit error rate (BER)
Shannon capacity theorem, Huffman coding, linear block codes, cyclic codes
Smith chart, transmission line matching, rectangular waveguides, dipole antenna radiation

papers.paper_name: Section 2: Computer Science & IT Technical Curriculum

topics.title: Discrete Mathematics & Graph Theory
topics.description: Propositional logic, predicate calculus, sets, relations, lattice theory, combinatorics, graph coloring, and trees.
sub_points: First-order logic, inference rules, equivalence, satisfiability
Partial orders, equivalence relations, recurrence relations, generating functions
Graph isomorphisms, Eulerian and Hamiltonian graphs, planar graphs, vertex coloring

topics.title: Data Structures, Algorithms & Theory of Computation
topics.description: Arrays, stacks, trees, heaps, graphs, asymptotic analysis, greedy, dynamic programming, DFA, regular expressions, and Turing machines.
sub_points: Binary search trees, AVL trees, B-trees, Red-Black trees, heap sort, hash tables
Divide and conquer, greedy algorithms, dynamic programming (knapsack, LCS), graph traversals
Regular languages, pumping lemma for regular and context-free languages, pushdown automata
Turing machines, Church-Turing thesis, decidability, halting problem, NP-completeness

topics.title: Computer Organization, Operating Systems & Compiler Design
topics.description: Pipelining, cache memory, process scheduling, synchronization, virtual memory, lexical analysis, and syntax-directed translation.
sub_points: Instruction pipelining, hazards, memory hierarchy, cache coherence, virtual memory
Processes, threads, CPU scheduling algorithms, mutexes, semaphores, deadlock detection
Paging, segmentation, page replacement algorithms, file system allocation
Lexical analysis, LL(1) and LR parsers (SLR, CLR, LALR), intermediate code generation

topics.title: Databases & Computer Networks
topics.description: ER models, relational algebra, SQL, normal forms (1NF to BCNF), transactions, TCP/IP protocol suite, routing algorithms.
sub_points: Relational calculus, SQL queries, functional dependencies, 3NF and BCNF normalization
ACID properties, serializability, two-phase locking protocol (2PL), crash recovery
OSI and TCP/IP models, sliding window protocols, congestion control (TCP Reno/Tahoe)
IPv4/IPv6 addressing, subnetting, Dijkstra routing, Bellman-Ford, DNS, HTTP, SSL/TLS

topics.title: Process Thermodynamics, Heat & Mass Transfer
topics.description: Phase equilibria, activity coefficient models, shell heat conduction, distillation column design, and absorption kinetics.
sub_points: VLE calculations, Raoult's law, Wilson and NRTL models, chemical reaction equilibria
LMTD, NTU-effectiveness method, shell and tube heat exchangers, boiling and condensation
Fick's law, mass transfer coefficients, McCabe-Thiele method for binary distillation

topics.title: Chemical Reaction Engineering & Process Control
topics.description: Ideal reactors (batch, CSTR, PFR), residence time distribution, catalyst deactivation, Bode plots, and PID tuning.
sub_points: Kinetics of homogeneous and catalytic reactions, Arrhenius equation, reactor sizing
RTD measurement, dispersion model, E-curve and F-curve analysis
First and second order dynamic systems, transfer functions, stability margins of closed loops

topics.title: Sensors, Industrial Instrumentation & Optical Systems
topics.description: Resistive, capacitive, inductive sensors, piezoelectric transducers, flowmeters, pyrometers, and optical fibers.
sub_points: Strain gauges, LVDTs, capacitive displacement sensors, thermocouple laws, RTDs
Orifice meters, venturimeters, electromagnetic flowmeters, ultrasonic Doppler sensors
Lasers, photodetectors, optical fiber numerical aperture, dispersion characteristics
